title: Words to read and colour: Shaddah
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 35 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 35. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Shaddah). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: The shaddah
points: Looks like a small w: ـّ
First quiet (sukoon), then with the vowel

questions.q: Read «ثُمَّ» and press on the doubled letter.
Pupil PDF: read eight pairs (بَ / بَّ ...) and circle every shaddah. The teacher listens to today's group.
Extend: find a shaddah in Al-Fatihah.

questions.a: A) kal-laa. The laam has a shaddah: kal + laa.

questions.q: Think again: This little mark looks like a tiny 'w' (ـّ). What do you think it tells us to do?
questions.a: Say the letter twice: once with a sukoon, once with its vowel: rab-ba.
